verdict.rationale: Wave documents one narrow event-triggered automation. Overdue-invoice reminders automatically go out 3, 7, and 14 days after an invoice's due date (Pro), which is a preset trigger with limited timing choices rather than a general rule builder. Recurring invoices are a time-based schedule, not an event trigger, and auto-categorization of bank transactions shows no user-defined rules, so neither is credited here. Missing for 10: a general user-defined rule engine (custom conditions/triggers mapped to arbitrary actions), documented bank-transaction categorization rules, webhook or API event triggers, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Schedule reminders to automatically deploy 3, 7, and 14 days after sent invoices are due, so you don't have to keep chasing customers.
Automatically send overdue reminders with Pro
